§6Robots§f

§aAutonomous mobile computers that mine, build, farm, and level up.§f
Robots are fully programmable. Write Lua scripts, deploy them, and watch them work.

§6Movement§f:
Moving costs §e15 energy§f per block, turning costs §e2.5 energy§f. Default flight height is §e8 blocks§f above a solid surface. Hover Upgrade Tier 1 raises it to §e64§f, Tier 2 to §e256§f.

§6Leveling§f:
Robots gain XP from actions (breaking, placing, attacking). Max level is 30. Each level adds §e+5000 energy buffer§f (20,000 at level 0, 170,000 at level 30), §e+1% tool efficiency§f (base 10% durability loss per use), and §e+2% harvest speed§f.

§6Charging§f:
Place a Charger block next to a robot. It transfers up to §e100 energy/tick§f at full redstone signal (15). Signal 8 charges at half speed.

§cWARNING:§f Robots consume 0.25 energy/tick just existing. Running out of power mid-job is embarrassing.
